claims.claim: This is a scrap LG Flatron TV
claims.evidence: Witness confirms 'LG' logo on bezel but model name 'Flatron' is not legible in the report; model field is null.
Screen shown dusty with no picture, but witness notes the set's power state was not tested; dark screen alone does not prove fault.

claims.claim: Sold as is for parts or recycling
claims.evidence: This is a sale-condition statement, not something a photo can confirm or deny.
Logistics term, not visible in any photo.
No location-identifying detail (street sign, landmark) in the photo; only a generic indoor background is shown.

risks.risk: TV may be completely dead (no power at all) vs. partially working
risks.proof: A clip of the seller plugging it in and showing the screen attempt to light up or show a logo

risks.risk: Missing remote and power/AV cables, affecting resale or testing value
risks.proof: A single photo showing remote and cables laid next to the unit
risks.if_unproven: price as unit only, no accessories

risks.risk: Cracks, dents, or back-panel damage not visible in the front-angle shot
risks.proof: Photos of the back, sides, and base of the TV
risks.if_unproven: price as possibly physically damaged, worst case

risks.risk: Internal component value (copper, flyback, CRT tube) unknown, affecting scrap/recycling worth
risks.proof: A photo of the open back panel or internal board if seller is willing
risks.if_unproven: price as standard external scrap only, no bonus for internals

risks.risk: True model (Flatron vs. generic LG) unconfirmed, affecting any resale-as-working value
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model/serial label on the back or bottom
risks.if_unproven: price as unidentified generic LG CRT, not the named model

proof_requests: Video of the TV being plugged in and powered on
Photos of the back, sides, and base of the unit
Close-up photo of the model/serial sticker
Photo showing any included remote, power cable, or AV cables (or confirmation none exist)
response.reason: The witness positively identifies a dusty, unpowered LG CRT TV with no accessories visible, so it can be priced at worst case as non-functional scrap/parts stock pending any proof of power-on function or intact accessories.
